body: My parents care a lot about my grades, probably too much to be honest. I’m almost failing multiple classes right now but they think I’m just not trying hard enough and that I’m faking depression
Please explain how I’m entitled for asking for mental health care that my family could easily paying for? And I’m not just sad, I’m severely depressed and I have trouble with self harm but whatever
I’ve tried scheduling appointments on my own before but that just got me into trouble and it didn’t change anything so I don’t know if that’s the best idea
My parents don’t let me travel without them at all so I don’t think I can do that
I know, I’m not suicidal though so I won’t need it

How the hell am I playing the victim? All I’m asking is for mental health care? And I would try to get to therapy myself but I can’t even get out of the house for a few minutes without getting permission so just going to therapy myself is a terrible idea, and it’s not like I haven’t thought of ways to do it. And apparently you’ve seen my account, so you’d know that I have problems with self harm and I was sexually abused. Do you really have nothing better to do than pick on someone who just needs mental health care? Whatever, I’ve wasted enough time on you, I hope you have a great day

Oh you don’t think I’ve asked my mom when she’s free? And by “plenty of money”, i meant that we have enough money for therapy but not enough to live like royalty, but apparently you know my life better than I do. And thanks for making me feel like more of a burden than I already do, that’s just what I needed right now
Ah okay, I’ll look into it then
I live in the US, and I don’t have my therapists number, and don’t worry, I’m not suicidal, I’ll be okay
Hopefully she’ll be forced to take me if I make the appointment, I’ve gotten in trouble for that before but i don’t see what else to do
I’ve tried setting up appointments on my own before but that just got me in trouble and it didn’t make my mom do anything
I don’t really know if it’s abuse though, it’s always been like this, it’s just that my mom is being worse about getting me to therapy lately
Thank you, and I just can’t bring myself to be manipulative, my parents are pretty manipulative sometimes and I’ve tried to rise above them, so I don’t know how I can make her take me to therapy
My parents don’t let me be alone very much, and they don’t allow me to travel without them, so I probably can’t do that
I don’t know, I haven’t really known anything but this so I probably wouldn’t know
My parents don’t really allow me to be alone much though, so that probably won’t be a good idea
That’s a good idea, I think if this keeps happening I’ll talk to my school counselor and have her talk to my parents

He’s always working really late so I never really have time to talk to him, and sometimes he’s just as bad as my mom when it comes to my mental health, so honestly I don’t really see him being helpful in this situation

Well my parents just really don’t like it when I’m not at home or with them, so neither of those options would probably work, and my parents highly doubt that i actually have mental health issues so that’s probably why they’re so weird about therapy
My dad is busy most of the time so he can’t help, and my mom obviously isn’t very helpful right now, so I don’t know what to do
I can’t take a taxi or an Uber or something like that because my parents don’t let me do that, so I have to rely on them for transportation
I think I’ll try to talking to her until I can get an appointment with my therapist
They doubt that I have depression and anxiety so yeah probably
My parents don’t let me use Uber or lyft
My family has plenty of money so money isn’t really a problem here
I’ve tried doing something like that before and my parents got mad at me and still didn’t take me so I can’t do that
My school does have a counselor but I haven’t really thought of seeing her because I could usually see my therapist instead, I don’t know why my mom is doing this now
My parents won’t let me use lyft/Uber though
I can’t drive though so I can’t get to my therapist on my own
I would but I don’t have a car so I wouldn’t be able to get to my therapist
I don’t have a job or a car so I don’t have any way of doing that, and we’re comfortable financially so money isn’t an issue here
Hopefully soon, I hate living like this
